prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid edge bent inward. Damage pattern is largely consistent with the reported rear impact, and the panels show no signs of older repairs or prior collision work. Plan is to replace the bumper cover and tail lamp, straighten the trunk lid flange, refinish the rear quarter panel to match, and recalibrate the parking sensors. The labor hours submitted match the scope of this work, and the supporting invoices show no duplicate charges. Estimate is recommended for approval as written.
